prompt:
Edit ONLY the PLAYER EXPLOSION / DEATH sequence row of this pixel art sprite sheet. Do NOT change anything else — keep all top-down player cars, all enemy driving cars, the enemy STUNNED white/grey frames, all flags (blank, S, L), and the smoke/gas cloud row EXACTLY as they are.

For the explosion sequence, make the FIRE MUCH BIGGER and more dramatic. Redraw it as a 6-frame sequence in the same retro pixel art style, palette and outlines:
Frame 1: bright white-hot ignition flash on the blue car with radiating sparks.
Frame 2: a LARGE growing fireball beginning to engulf the blue car, big red/orange/yellow flames shooting outward.
Frame 3: a MASSIVE, ROARING fireball completely consuming the blue car — huge intense flames of red, orange, and bright yellow shooting outward in all directions, flying debris and sparks, filling the whole cell. This is the biggest, brightest frame.
Frame 4: still a huge fireball but starting to collapse, flames turning darker orange with heavy smoke and embers mixing in.
Frame 5: flames dying down into thick dark smoke revealing the beginning of a black burnt car wreck.
Frame 6: the final BLACK BURNT WRECKAGE of the car with a few last smoke wisps (keep this final wreckage look, it is perfect).

Emphasis: frames 2, 3 and 4 must show a much larger, brighter, more intense fireball with large flames than before. Keep the same pixel scale and cell grid so it aligns with the rest of the sheet.
